errors.description: Stated mark positions are wrong: intervals of lengths δ,2δ,…,2^nδ in order put Liu's marks at (2^j−1)δ, not 2^jδ. Harmless slip, since only the interval lengths (9) are used; marks are still distinct interior points.
errors.quote: Thus his marks are \(2^j\delta\) for \(1\le j\le n\), all distinct and strictly inside the stick.

parsed.notes: Drafting lemma (greedy optimal, value = alternating sum) verified by direct computation. Refinement lemma: tree-component/bipartition lower bound and overlay-construction upper bound (cut count ≤ q−1) both check out. Pigeonhole on 2^{n+1} subset sums gives upper bound; powers-of-two lengths give matching lower bound. Sections 5–6 are extraneous but harmless.
